title: How a 1‑Meter‑Wide Space Telescope Captured a Hidden Exoplanet Atmosphere

scenes.text: A 1‑meter telescope revealed a secret gas envelope around a distant world
The instrument detected sodium absorption lines, confirming an atmosphere on the super‑Earth GJ 1132 b
Small telescopes can still unveil alien skies
scenes.label: SMALL TELESCOPE POWER
scenes.sub: Even modest observatories can study exoplanet gases

scenes.text: Follow for a new science fact every day.

description: A modest 1‑meter telescope captured sodium signatures in the atmosphere of the nearby super‑Earth GJ 1132 b, proving that even smaller instruments can probe alien worlds. Follow for daily science!
